name: cortexdb-lexical-smoke
description: Small self-contained IR set for CortexDB retrieval-quality regression tracking.

documents.title: Go programming language
documents.content: Go, also called Golang, is a statically typed compiled language from Google with goroutines and channels for concurrency.

documents.title: Rust programming language
documents.content: Rust is a systems programming language focused on memory safety without a garbage collector, using ownership and borrowing.

documents.title: Python programming language
documents.content: Python is a dynamically typed interpreted language popular for data science, scripting, and machine learning.

documents.title: SQLite database
documents.content: SQLite is an embedded single-file SQL database engine with no separate server process, widely used on mobile and desktop.

documents.title: PostgreSQL database
documents.content: PostgreSQL is an advanced open-source relational database supporting transactions, JSON, and full-text search.

documents.title: Qdrant vector database
documents.content: Qdrant is a vector similarity search engine written in Rust for storing embeddings and running nearest-neighbor queries.

documents.title: HNSW index
documents.content: Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs are an approximate nearest neighbor index giving fast high-recall vector search.

documents.title: SQLite FTS5
documents.content: FTS5 is the SQLite full-text search extension providing BM25 ranking over tokenized text columns.

documents.title: BM25 ranking
documents.content: BM25 is a bag-of-words ranking function scoring documents by term frequency and inverse document frequency for keyword search.

documents.title: Retrieval augmented generation
documents.content: RAG augments a language model by retrieving relevant documents and adding them to the prompt before generation.

documents.title: Text embeddings
documents.content: An embedding maps text to a dense vector so semantically similar sentences land close together in vector space.

documents.title: SPARQL query language
documents.content: SPARQL is the query language for RDF graphs, matching triple patterns to select, ask, or construct results.

documents.title: RDF triples
documents.content: RDF represents knowledge as subject predicate object triples forming a directed labeled graph.

documents.title: SHACL validation
documents.content: SHACL defines shapes to validate that RDF data meets constraints like datatype, cardinality, and value ranges.

documents.title: Knowledge graph
documents.content: A knowledge graph stores entities and the relationships between them, enabling queries over connected facts.

documents.title: Model Context Protocol
documents.content: MCP is a protocol that lets AI assistants call external tools and data sources over a standard stdio or socket transport.

documents.title: Goroutines
documents.content: A goroutine is a lightweight thread managed by the Go runtime, cheap enough to spawn thousands concurrently.

documents.title: Rust ownership
documents.content: Ownership is Rust's compile-time discipline where each value has a single owner, freeing memory deterministically without a collector.

documents.title: Transformer model
documents.content: The transformer is a neural network architecture using self-attention, the basis of modern large language models.

documents.title: Write-ahead logging
documents.content: Write-ahead logging lets a database commit changes to a log first, improving concurrency for readers and writers.

documents.title: Cosine similarity
documents.content: Cosine similarity measures the angle between two vectors, a common distance for comparing embeddings.

documents.title: Tokenizer
documents.content: A tokenizer splits text into tokens; FTS engines and language models use tokenizers to break text into searchable units.

documents.title: gRPC framework
documents.content: gRPC is a high-performance remote procedure call framework using protocol buffers over HTTP/2.

documents.title: Anthropic
documents.content: Anthropic is an AI safety company that builds the Claude family of large language models.
